title: Listing extraction copies source prose and leaves missing words for the operator

source.ref: Daniel 2026-10-26: AI coaches and extracts facts without creating content for people

detail: Listing extraction no longer requests generated or inferred title/description copy or applies the writing voice primer. The pure coercer requires a fact with an exact source citation containing the exact prose value, so an unrelated real citation cannot launder new wording. Review/list reads suppress unsupported historical title/description and their badges without writing on read. Publish independently rechecks stored provenance, blocks a missing title before public writes and omits unsupported descriptions. Matching human-edited provenance remains valid. The review board offers fixed writing questions for missing fields; manual editing, staff gates, budgets/accounting, photos and claim flow remain. Extracted detail values must occur in the paste. This proves copy provenance, not the truth of pasted claims, semantic source safety or live provider acceptance; controlled factual normalization remains subject to operator review.

verify.evidence: Actual-source coercion/publish probe exercises adversarial unrelated citation, generated legacy title denial before writes, exact source excerpts and human-authored payload preservation with inert IO. Focused suites cover provider boundaries, actual intake/review persistence, rendered missing-field guidance, manual edits, public publish payload and existing seeder behavior. Full CI/preview and authenticated production acceptance remain separate.
